modules.module_title: Conduct training sessions, demonstrations, meetings and workshops

pcs.pc_description: demonstrate the use of tools, equipment and relevant technologies, along with their applicability to the local conditions
deliver lectures to share information with the community members on best fishing/ aquaculture practices
conduct group discussions to encourage and stimulate the community members to talk about their concerns and reach mutually-agreed solutions

modules.module_title: Counsel and assist the fishing/ aquaculture community members

pcs.pc_description: counsel the community members about the relevant schemes and support mechanisms such as the Sagar Mala Project, Common Service Centres (CSCs), deposit schemes and other banking services, etc.
advise the community members about the selection of appropriate fresh/ brackish/ marine water fish/ crustacean species to be cultured based on trends and profitability
educate the community members about different capture and culture fisheries methods such as mono/ mixed/ poly culture and the applicable scientific factors
assist the community members in setting up fishing enterprises such as fish seed production or fish processing unit
facilitate access to resources such as equipment, financial aid, licenses, and permits required for their activities
educate the community members about modern tools & technologies including fishing crafts, gears and nets used in different fisheries systems
educate the community members about the aquaculture farm preparation activities such as pond preparation, water quality management, eradication of aquatic weeds and predators, etc.
advise the community members about the fish/ crustacean feed management along with the common diseases and the appropriate preventive/ remedial measures to be taken
counsel the community members about the optimisation of resources and waste management
educate the community members about the value chain and market linkages
promote sustainable fisheries management across the value chain

advise the community members about the personal insurance facility and insurance on various fishing assets and projects to protect against Permanent Total Disability due to Accident (PTD), diseases, natural calamities, etc.
assist the community members in securing insurance and submitting insurance claims
counsel the community members about the safe handling of fish, value-addition activities, etc.
educate the community members about the benefits and process of creating Self-Help Groups (SHGs) to achieve the common objectives collectively
assist the community members in creating SHGs along with organising and utilising resources
identify and connect with the relevant Non- governmental Organisations (NGOs) and Voluntary Organisations (VOs) for the welfare of the fishing community
conduct field visits/ research to identify solutions to the problems encountered by the fishing community in the field
identify social, economic and technical barriers encountered by the fishery community and their solutions
